why.en: a / b is a division of two ints, so it gives 3 before it is stored in d. d is 3.0, not 3.5. Also, c + 1 is an int (100), not the char 'd'.
why.zh: a / b 是两个 int 相除，在存进 d 之前结果已经是 3，所以 d 是 3.0，不是 3.5。另外，c + 1 是 int（100），不是字符 'd'。

why.en: c is still a char variable, so printing it shows the character 'c'. Only (c + 1) is an int.
why.zh: c 仍然是 char 变量，所以打印它显示的是字符 'c'。只有 (c + 1) 是 int。

why.en: The 100 and the c are right, but d is 3.0. The division happens in int arithmetic before the assignment to a double.
why.zh: 100 和 c 是对的，但 d 是 3.0。除法在赋值给 double 之前就已经按 int 运算完成了。

why.en: Correct. a / b is 3 (int division), widened to 3.0. c += 2 has a built-in cast and makes c equal to 'c'. In (c + 1) the char is promoted to int, so the sum is 99 + 1 = 100.
why.zh: 正确。a / b 是 3（int 除法），再被扩宽成 3.0。c += 2 带有隐含的强制转换，使 c 变成 'c'。在 (c + 1) 里 char 被提升为 int，所以结果是 99 + 1 = 100。

title.en: A static counter and an instance field
title.zh: 静态计数器与实例字段

why.en: number is an instance field, but its value was copied from issued at the moment of construction. For the third ticket issued was 3.
why.zh: number 是实例字段，但它的值是在构造那一刻从 issued 复制来的。第三张票构造时 issued 是 3。

why.en: Correct. issued exists once for the whole class and is 3 after three constructions. The third ticket copied 3 into its own final field number.
why.zh: 正确。issued 对整个类只有一份，三次构造之后是 3。第三张票把 3 复制进了自己的 final 字段 number。

why.en: issued is shared. It is not reset for each object, so it is 3 and not 1.
why.zh: issued 是共享的，不会为每个对象重置，所以它是 3，不是 1。

why.en: This would be right if every Ticket had its own issued. A static field belongs to the class and is shared by all objects.
why.zh: 如果每个 Ticket 都有自己的 issued，这个答案才对。静态字段属于类，由所有对象共享。

why.en: Correct. The line break after 42 is still unread. nextLine consumes it and returns the empty text before it. To read the next line, call nextLine once more.
why.zh: 正确。42 后面的换行符仍未被读取。nextLine 消耗掉它，并返回它前面的空文本。要读取下一行，需要再调用一次 nextLine。

why.en: nextInt reads only the token 42 and stops right before the line break. nextLine then returns the rest of the current line, which is empty.
why.zh: nextInt 只读取词法项 42，停在换行符之前。nextLine 随后返回当前行剩下的部分，也就是空的。

why.en: 42 has already been consumed by nextInt.
why.zh: 42 已经被 nextInt 读走了。

why.en: nextInt succeeded because 42 is a valid integer. The exception comes from nextInt when the next token is not a number.
why.zh: nextInt 成功了，因为 42 是合法的整数。InputMismatchException 是在下一个词法项不是数字时由 nextInt 抛出的。

prompt.en: A program writes to a DataOutputStream: writeInt(258), then writeShort(7). How many bytes are written, and what are they, as unsigned decimal numbers? (Hint: 258 = 1 * 256 + 2.)
prompt.zh: 一个程序向 DataOutputStream 写入：先 writeInt(258)，再 writeShort(7)。一共写出多少个字节？这些字节（按无符号十进制数）是什么？（提示：258 = 1 * 256 + 2。）

why.en: Correct. An int is 4 bytes and a short is 2 bytes. DataOutputStream always writes the most significant byte first (big-endian).
why.zh: 正确。int 占 4 个字节，short 占 2 个字节。DataOutputStream 总是先写最高位字节（大端序）。

why.en: The count is right, but this is little-endian order. DataOutputStream does not use it.
why.zh: 个数是对的，但这是小端序。DataOutputStream 不使用它。

why.en: A data stream writes binary values, not digits as text. A PrintWriter would write text.
why.zh: 数据流写出的是二进制值，而不是文本形式的数字。写文本要用 PrintWriter。

text.en: 5 bytes: 258 needs only 2 bytes, so it is stored short
text.zh: 5 个字节：258 只需要 2 个字节，所以按短的方式存储

why.en: The width is fixed by the method, not by the value. writeInt always writes exactly 4 bytes.
why.zh: 宽度由方法决定，而不是由值决定。writeInt 总是恰好写出 4 个字节。

title.en: Which collection fits these three rules?
title.zh: 哪种集合符合这三条要求？

prompt.en: Leon stores the names of players. The names must stay in the order in which the players joined. The same name must never appear twice. He often asks "is this name already in?". Which collection is the best choice?
prompt.zh: Leon 要保存玩家的名字。名字要保持玩家加入的先后顺序。同一个名字不能出现两次。他经常要问“这个名字已经在里面了吗？”。哪种集合最合适？

why.en: It keeps the order, but it allows duplicates and contains scans the whole list.
why.zh: 它保持顺序，但允许重复，而且 contains 要扫描整个列表。

why.en: No duplicates and a fast contains, but the iteration order is not the join order.
why.zh: 没有重复，contains 也很快，但遍历顺序并不是加入的顺序。

why.en: Correct. It is a set (no duplicates), contains is fast on average, and it iterates in insertion order.
why.zh: 正确。它是集合（没有重复），contains 平均很快，并且按插入顺序遍历。

why.en: No duplicates, but it keeps the names sorted alphabetically, not in join order.
why.zh: 没有重复，但它按字母顺序排序，而不是按加入顺序。

title.zh: 兄弟类之间的强制转换

prompt.en: The statements below are inside main. What happens when the program is compiled?
prompt.zh: 下面的语句写在 main 里面。编译这个程序时会发生什么？

text.en: It compiles, and line 2 throws a ClassCastException when it runs.
text.zh: 它能通过编译，运行到第 2 行时抛出 ClassCastException。

why.en: Line 2 would indeed fail at run time, because the object is a Dog. But the program never gets that far: line 3 is rejected at compile time.
why.zh: 第 2 行在运行时确实会失败，因为对象是 Dog。但程序根本运行不到那里：第 3 行在编译时就被拒绝了。

text.en: It does not compile, because line 3 is an error.
text.zh: 它无法通过编译，因为第 3 行有错误。

why.en: Correct. d has the declared type Dog, and Dog and Cat are unrelated siblings. The compiler can prove that no Dog is a Cat, so it refuses the cast.
why.zh: 正确。d 的声明类型是 Dog，而 Dog 和 Cat 是互不相关的兄弟类。编译器可以证明没有任何 Dog 是 Cat，所以拒绝这个强制转换。

text.en: It does not compile, because line 2 is an error.
text.zh: 它无法通过编译，因为第 2 行有错误。

why.en: Line 2 is a cast from Animal down to Cat. A Cat is an Animal, so the compiler allows it, because a really could hold a Cat. Only the run-time type decides.
why.zh: 第 2 行是从 Animal 向下转换成 Cat。Cat 是 Animal，所以编译器允许它，因为 a 确实有可能装着 Cat。只有运行时的类型才能决定结果。

text.en: It compiles and runs without any error.
text.zh: 它能通过编译，也能无错误地运行。

why.en: Even if it compiled, line 2 would fail: a holds a Dog, and a Dog cannot be cast to Cat.
why.zh: 即使它能通过编译，第 2 行也会失败：a 里装的是 Dog，而 Dog 不能强制转换成 Cat。

title.en: When do you need an abstract class?

prompt.en: Which situation is a better fit for an abstract class than for an interface?
prompt.zh: 下面哪种情况更适合用抽象类，而不是接口？

text.en: Duck, Robot and Kite are unrelated classes, and each must offer fly().
text.zh: Duck、Robot 和 Kite 是互不相关的类，每个都必须提供 fly()。

why.en: This is a capability shared by unrelated classes, with no shared state. An interface is the natural choice, and each class can still extend its own parent.
why.zh: 这是互不相关的类共有的一种能力，没有共享状态。接口是自然的选择，而且每个类仍然可以继承自己的父类。

text.en: A class must promise two different abilities, Printable and Savable.
text.zh: 一个类必须承诺具备两种不同的能力：Printable 和 Savable。

why.en: A class can extend only one class but can implement many interfaces, so this needs interfaces.
why.zh: 一个类只能继承一个类，但可以实现多个接口，所以这里需要的是接口。

text.en: Several shape classes share a field id and a constructor that sets it, share a finished describe() method, and each must supply its own area().
text.zh: 几个图形类共享字段 id 和设置它的构造器，共享一个写好的 describe() 方法，每个类还必须提供自己的 area()。

why.en: Correct. An abstract class can hold fields, a constructor and ready-made methods, and leave area() abstract. An interface cannot hold instance fields or a constructor.
why.zh: 正确。抽象类可以有字段、构造器和现成的方法，同时把 area() 留作抽象方法。接口不能有实例字段，也不能有构造器。

text.en: Callers should be able to pass a lambda where this type is expected.
text.zh: 调用者应当能在需要这个类型的地方传入一个 lambda。

why.en: A lambda can only implement a functional interface. It cannot create an instance of an abstract class.
why.zh: lambda 只能实现函数式接口，不能创建抽象类的实例。

title.en: Why does this generic method not compile?
title.zh: 这个泛型方法为什么无法编译？

prompt.en: This method does not compile. What is the reason, and what is the fix?
prompt.zh: 这个方法无法编译。原因是什么？怎样修正？

text.en: Without a bound, the compiler knows only that T is some Object, and Object has no compareTo. Fix: declare <T extends Comparable<T>>.
text.zh: 没有界限时，编译器只知道 T 是某种 Object，而 Object 没有 compareTo。修正：声明为 <T extends Comparable<T>>。

why.en: Correct. The bound promises that every T can be compared with another T, which makes compareTo available.
why.zh: 正确。界限承诺每个 T 都能与另一个 T 比较，这样 compareTo 就可以使用了。

text.en: compareTo returns an int, not a boolean. Fix: compare with == instead.
text.zh: compareTo 返回 int，不是 boolean。修正：改用 == 比较。

why.en: Comparing the int result with 0 is exactly the right way. The compiler's complaint is about the method, not about the comparison.
why.zh: 把 int 结果与 0 比较正是正确的做法。编译器抱怨的是方法找不到，而不是这个比较。

text.en: A generic method cannot be static. Fix: make it an instance method.
text.zh: 泛型方法不能是 static。修正：改成实例方法。

why.en: Static generic methods are allowed, and they are very common. The type parameter list <T> is declared on the method itself.
why.zh: 静态泛型方法是允许的，而且非常常见。类型参数列表 <T> 就声明在方法本身上。

text.en: T must be a primitive type. Fix: write int instead of T.
text.zh: T 必须是基本类型。修正：把 T 写成 int。

why.en: Type parameters can only stand for reference types. A primitive such as int cannot be used as T (its wrapper class Integer can).
why.zh: 类型参数只能代表引用类型。int 这样的基本类型不能用作 T（它的包装类 Integer 可以）。

title.zh: 使用通配符时哪条语句能编译？

prompt.en: The method copy has two wildcard parameters. Exactly one of the statements below, if it were the body of the method, compiles. Which one?
prompt.zh: 方法 copy 有两个通配符形参。下面的语句中，如果把它写成方法体，恰好有一条能够通过编译。是哪一条？

why.en: src is a producer (? extends). The compiler only knows its elements are some subtype of Number, which might be Double. It cannot allow any add except null.
why.zh: src 是生产者（? extends）。编译器只知道它的元素是 Number 的某个子类型，可能是 Double。除了 null 之外，它不允许任何 add。

why.en: dst is a consumer (? super). Its elements are some supertype of Number, so get can only promise an Object.
why.zh: dst 是消费者（? super）。它的元素是 Number 的某个父类型，所以 get 只能保证得到 Object。

why.en: Reading from src is allowed, but what you get is a Number. It would need a cast to become an Integer.
why.zh: 可以从 src 读取，但读到的是 Number。要变成 Integer 需要强制转换。

why.en: Correct. Whatever the real element type is, it is Number or a supertype, so it can hold any Number. A Double is a Number. This is "consumer super".
why.zh: 正确。无论真实的元素类型是什么，它都是 Number 或其父类型，所以能容纳任何 Number。Double 是 Number。这就是“消费者用 super”。

prompt.en: Exactly one of these four methods fails to compile. Which one?
prompt.zh: 这四个方法中恰好有一个无法编译。是哪一个？

why.en: IllegalStateException is a RuntimeException, so it is unchecked. The compiler does not require a catch or a throws clause.
why.zh: IllegalStateException 是 RuntimeException，属于非受检异常。编译器不要求 catch 或 throws 声明。

why.en: Correct. Exception is a checked exception. It must be caught or declared with throws, and b does neither.
why.zh: 正确。Exception 是受检查异常，必须捕获或用 throws 声明，而 b 两样都没有做。

why.en: The throws clause declares the checked exception, so the callers become responsible for it. The method itself compiles.
why.zh: throws 子句声明了这个受检查异常，于是责任交给了调用者。方法本身能通过编译。

why.en: The checked exception is caught inside the method by the catch block, so nothing escapes and no throws clause is needed.
why.zh: 受检查异常在方法内部被 catch 块捕获，没有任何异常逃出去，所以不需要 throws 子句。

title.en: A lambda that changes a local variable

prompt.en: What happens when this code is compiled and run?
prompt.zh: 编译并运行这段代码会发生什么？

why.en: That is what the programmer hoped for, but the program does not compile, so it never runs.
why.zh: 这是程序员希望的结果，但程序无法通过编译，所以根本不会运行。

text.en: Compile error: n is a different value on each pass, so it cannot be captured.
text.zh: 编译错误：n 在每一轮里的值都不同，所以不能被捕获。

why.en: In an enhanced for loop, n is a new variable for every pass and is never reassigned inside the body, so it is effectively final. Capturing n is fine.
why.zh: 在增强 for 循环里，n 在每一轮都是一个新变量，循环体里也从不对它重新赋值，所以它是事实上的 final。捕获 n 没有问题。

text.en: Compile error: total is changed inside the lambda, but a captured local variable must be final or effectively final.
text.zh: 编译错误：total 在 lambda 里被修改，但被捕获的局部变量必须是 final 或事实上的 final。

why.en: Correct. A lambda may read a local variable of the enclosing method only if that variable is never reassigned. A common workaround is a one-element array or an AtomicInteger.
why.zh: 正确。只有当外围方法的局部变量从不被重新赋值时，lambda 才可以读取它。常见的变通办法是使用单元素数组或 AtomicInteger。

text.en: It prints 0, because the lambda works on a copy of total.
text.zh: 打印 0，因为 lambda 操作的是 total 的副本。

why.en: Java does allow a lambda to read a copy of a captured value, but it refuses to let the lambda change it, precisely to avoid this confusion. The code is rejected.
why.zh: Java 允许 lambda 读取被捕获值的副本，但为了避免这种混淆，不允许 lambda 修改它。这段代码会被拒绝。
